title: Low-Cal Haloumi Chopped Salad
subtitle: with Black Barley and Sunflower Seeds
description: With a trio of super-healthy grains – rice, quinoa and barley – plus crunchy celery and sunflower seeds, sweet currants and golden haloumi, this salad is oh-so good and good for you too.

steps.text: Cook grain blend: Fill a medium saucepan three-quarters full with water and bring to the boil. Add the grain blend (see Kitchen notes) and cook for 20-22 mins until tender. Drain and cool slightly.

Prep ingredients: Meanwhile, crush 1 garlic clove. Thinly slice the celery and half the onion. Cut the haloumi into 1cm-thick slices. Put half the sunflower seeds (see Kitchen notes) in a cold medium frypan over medium heat. Toast, tossing, for 3-4 mins until evenly golden. Remove from the pan, reserving the pan.
Make dressing: Put the garlic, 1½ tbs balsamic vinegar and 1 tsp olive oil in a large bowl. Season with salt and pepper and stir to combine.
Pan-fry haloumi: Spray or brush the reserved pan with olive oil and heat over medium heat. Cook the haloumi for 1-2 mins each side until golden. Remove the pan from the heat.

Serve up: Coarsely chop the sunflower seeds. Add the celery, onion, grain blend, salad leaves and currants to the dressing and toss gently to combine. Divide among bowls and top with the haloumi. Scatter over the sunflower seeds and enjoy!

Kitchen notes: Our grain blend contains black barley, a highly nutritious grain with a nutty, slightly sweet flavour and chewy texture. It is the only grain that can go from field to fork without any processing. ~ As this is a low-calorie dish, we recommend using only half of the sunflower seeds. However, if you wish to add them all, the dish will taste just as delicious.
